---
title: Footnotes and repeated references
# footnotes.md: markdown-dialect.md §4.1
---

A named note[^a], the same note again[^a], and an inline note^[Inline content.].

[^a]: The first paragraph of a named note refers to another note[^b].

    A second paragraph in the same note.

[^b]: A nested footnote reference's content.

[^unused]: This definition is intentionally unreferenced.
